title: Short URLs
description: Schema for _data/short-urls.yml — the registry of /s/<ID> share pages.

propertyNames.description: Base62 short ID. 2 chars now; 3 is the documented non-breaking extension.

^[A-Za-z0-9]{2,3}$.description: A single share page definition. Mirrors the s/<ID>.md front matter.

redirect_to.description: Same-site path the share URL redirects to (e.g. /career/changelog/#changelog-9-0-0). Required on every entry.

same_as.description: Alias another entry: inherit its title, description and banner. Must point at a regular (non-alias) entry; redirect_to stays local and title/description may be overridden locally. Aliases may not set bannertagline.

title.description: OG title shown on the share card. Required on regular entries, optional override on aliases.

description.description: OG description shown on the share card. Required on regular entries, optional override on aliases.

bannertagline.description: Dynamic tagline drawn on the social banner. Falls back to title. Regular entries only; aliases inherit the target's tagline.

oneOf.description: Regular entry: no same_as, full metadata.
Alias entry: same_as required, banner text inherited.
